title: Append to a Non-Empty Circular Linked List

blocks.content: Append to a Non-Empty Circular Linked List
If the list is not empty, then we follow the given steps to append a node.
Like in a singly linked list, we must traverse to the end of the list.
However, instead of traversing until we reach nullptr, here, we traverse until the next of a node points to the head node.

blocks.alt: Traverse to the last node of a circular list

blocks.content: 2. Link the last node to the new node.
To link the nodes, we set the next of the last node (where we are currently in) to the new node.

// The next of the current node is new_node
current->next = new_node;
To complete a circle, we set the new node to point back to the head of the list.

// new_node points to head
new_node->next = head;
